name: Akifusa Oki
source:
"I want to protect you, so no matter the troubles I will become stronger."

A personal attendant to Princess Tamayori. He is also an officer in command of a company of soldiers stationed in Kifu. His manner is overly serious, and he always conducts himself as a soldier. However, his attitude can be considered a weakness as well.
